findings: Source comments still mention0.15seconds and traffic within40m. Actual moving BaseI is0.25when AlertOn and AlertUntil, otherwise0.4, multiplied separately by PF/PFT. Stationary/reversing uses0.8*precision. Passing has0.25sleep. Do not cite comments as actual measured cadence.
TrafficNear is assigned by nearby crewed traffic, but the inspected actual BaseI does not read it directly. TrafficCap also sets AlertUntil for crewed peers within25m.

CBE previously requested1second only for actual limiting traffic/recovery/active passage, otherwise4seconds. A relevant approaching/crossing peer could remain unconstraining on that sample and leave the next observation at cruise cadence.
implementation: DrivingFollowingCap appends a sixth observational bool to its unchanged five-field result prefix. Same-height forward lane hull inside max40m/nominal stopping room sets it only for closing speed>0.5m/s or non-following traffic; stable same-speed following does not. Overlapping relevant crossing windows also set it.
Reuses the existing64-candidate/eight-corner observation; no new query, handler or scheduler. Early refusal results retain conservative caps and appropriate hint defaults.

DrivingAssistStart captures the hint before gate/body/pedestrian rows can replace the cap. It publishes the hint as local state field11 only inside existing current-owner/native-cap transaction and requests1second. DrivingOperationStep also reads it under matching owned state and requests the same cadence; phase remains based on actual limiting work. Existing release removes the entire state.
Braking reaction remains4seconds. No hint increases speed, relaxes traffic clearance, grants priority or authorizes route recovery. Convoy cadence remains1second.
limits: Scheduler budgets/load can delay callbacks;1second is a request, not guaranteed latency.
Relevant groups/vehicles may scan more frequently. Aggregate scan cost, convoy flow, braking, dense traffic, fast/modded hulls and5%median10%p95 need physical measurement.
